summary.one_liner: Waitress is a production-quality, pure-Python WSGI server for running Python web applications.
summary.what_it_does: Waitress is a WSGI server written in pure Python. According to the README it has no dependencies beyond the Python standard library. It runs on CPython on Unix and Windows under Python 3.9+, and the README says it is also known to run on PyPy 3 on UNIX. It supports HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/1.1. The README describes its performance as "very acceptable" and points to the "docs" directory of the package for further information. The README excerpt provided does not include installation or usage commands.
use_cases: serve a WSGI web application in production
run a Pyramid app with a pure-Python server
host Python web apps on Unix or Windows
deploy a WSGI app on PyPy 3
serve HTTP/1.1 traffic from a Python process
notable: Pure-Python with no dependencies outside the standard library
Runs on both Unix and Windows under CPython
Listed in awesome-python under Web Servers as multi-threaded and the server behind Pyramid
caveats: Runs on PyPy 3 only on UNIX, per the README
README excerpt gives no install or usage instructions; see the docs directory
